generalAbilities.name: Smoke Vision
generalAbilities.description: Smoke doesn't impair a cinder dragon's vision; they ignore the Concealed condition from smoke.

defensiveAbilities.name: Boiling Blood
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The dragon is critically hit with a melee attack

Effect The dragon's superheated blood spills onto the attacker. The target takes 10d6 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 41 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Dragon Heat
defensiveAbilities.description: 5 feet, 4d6 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 37 Reflex Saving Throw save)

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
90 feet DC 39 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike (Jaws only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: All Becomes Flame
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dragon curses a creature within 60 feet to have its magic replaced with primordial flames. The creature must attempt a DC 39 Will Saving Throw save. Regardless of the result, the target becomes temporarily immune for 1 day.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is cursed for 1 round. While cursed, any damage the cursed creature would deal by any means becomes fire damage, regardless of the original damage type. The cursed creature can temporarily suppress the curse for 1 round as an action.

Failure As success, but the curse's duration is 1 hour.

Critical Failure As success, but the curse's duration is 1 day.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one wing Strike in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon recharges their Pyre Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pyre Breath
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon breathes a blast of flame that deals 18d6 Fire Damage damage in a 60ft Type:cone (Basic DC 41 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures that critically fail their save catch fire, taking 2d6 Persistent,fire Damage damage. The area then fills with black smoke for 1 minute. This has the effects of mist, except it fills the cone's area. The dragon can't use Pyre Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stoke the Flames
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon intensifies nearby fires. Every foe within 60 feet that is taking persistent fire damage takes 5d6 Fire Damage damage.
